'''Vorghris''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]].<ref name="KFH" /> Circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''Living Force Campaign Guide'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the Living Force adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' moved the campaign forward ten years to the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Kilassin For Hire]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> while hunting [[kilassin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], a [[Unidentified Tarasin hunter|Tarasin hunter]] noted that the underbelly of a kilassin smelled of vorghris leaves.<ref name="KFH" />
